limitations: Derived data only; no benchmark, install, browser, server or product operation was rerun.
These are separate observational cohorts. Node changed from 22.23.3 to 22.23.4, product source and lock identity changed; no causal timing attribution or performance verdict is justified.
CPU affinity/frequency, background load, GC, free memory and OS caches were not controlled. No SLO or statistical significance is asserted.
All finite recorded values are included, even for failed attempts; measured samples and warmups are separate.
Four cold aggregate rows summarize existing single-process samples; they add zero attempts.
PerCommandMs summarizes sample averages of batch duration/historyFrames, not individual command latency observations.
The frozen protocol, tools, fixture counts and serialized sizes match; generated UUIDs make the actual corpora different.
Direct warm PlaneGCS bypasses the browser LRU. Cache-hit timings, browser cold-start and native heap/RSS were not measured.
Fresh Node WASM initialization is not OS disk-cache cold. Memory host timings are not browser/disk/network Save/Open timings.
Original acceptedBaseline:false and acceptance:PENDING states remain unchanged. Controller acceptance is separate.
Diagnostic bootstrap timings remain in raw reports and are not added to the 53 repeated case-metric rows.
